description: Create an Airflow DAG for health_portal that pulls nightly lab-result batches from a partner API. The DAG should: (1) use an HttpSensor to poll GET /v2/batches/{{ ds }}/status until the JSON body reports state == 'READY', (2) download the batch manifest, (3) fetch each file listed in the manifest into GCS, (4) load the files into a BigQuery raw table using a load job with WRITE_TRUNCATE on the day partition, (5) run a row-count reconciliation between the manifest and the loaded partition. The DAG runs daily at 03:30 UTC. The sensor should poll every 5 minutes with exponential backoff, time out after 3 hours, and treat HTTP 404 as 'not ready yet' rather than as a failure.
edge_cases: HttpSensor raises on 404 by default; response_check must handle 404 as False instead of failing the task
A state of 'FAILED' in the status body must fail the sensor immediately rather than polling until timeout
Load must target the single day partition with WRITE_TRUNCATE so reruns are idempotent
Manifest row count of zero is valid on holidays and must not fail reconciliation
Reconciliation mismatch must fail the DAG
common_failure_modes: FM6: response_check returns True for any 200 response without inspecting the state field
FM7: Reconciliation compares loaded rows against the table total instead of the day partition
FM6: WRITE_APPEND on rerun duplicates the whole batch
